subject: Re: project updates
text:
Hi again,

Sorry to shoot this back before I have everything tidied, but I wanted to update you while it’s fresh. The homepage copy is in, and I finished the mobile banner this morning. I started on the blog template too, though I ran into the same friction we touched on in your note yesterday: you’d like the featured-post box to stretch full width, while I think it’ll look cramped on small screens unless we preserve side margins. I know your team trusts the current layout, and I’m not trying to overrule that, but I’m worried that a full-bleed image on tablets will crowd the headline. Could we keep the wide treatment for desktop and step back on mobile?

I’m also re-checking the contact form. It’s working on my end, though it may still need a spam filter before launch. Please let me know if you’d rather I prioritize the form polish instead of the next template; I can switch order easily. That might save time for everyone. I’ll leave that task open for now.

Everything else is tracking as planned. I’ll send a short build by Thursday if nothing else breaks. Thanks for bearing with the slightly scattered tone—today has been one of those days where I’m moving straight from one revision to the next without pausing to organize my thoughts properly.

Best,
